about.title: About
bio: Software engineer, startup founder and part-time student from Malaysia. Winner of the Best Malaysia Web Awards 2025, which arrived while he was somewhere in the Himalayas.
ABC was his first trip abroad without family or friends. He joined to take his aunty's place, knew no one at the airport, and came home with a whole crew, plus a certificate for reaching 4,130 m.
He built this site as a surprise for everyone who walked with him. Now he wants to go higher.
